author: OldManTigerMask
body:
Introduction

Hi! So the ATLAS Update has been released! YAY! It's so fun, but I really am noticing less and less chat messages, not because there are less, but because they aren't as noticeable. This thread unlike others will actually suggest ways to solve the problems. 

Objectives

Firstly, when an objective is completed, it isn't noticeable, it just is one bar in white with the team's name and colour, that's it. 
I think the message should be reverted back to the one in Avicore, as for it was much more noticeable and people payed attention to it. 

Noticing objectives when completed are important for the following reasons:

1. Defending
It helps when defending because although you have the sidebar, I honestly don't pay attention much to it and to be honest the chat is generally where I get most of the knowledge whether if the monument has been broken or not

2. Scoring

When running tournaments or scrimmages, it doesn't help not knowing who completed the objective as for you might be handing out points to those who break monuments.

Solution
Change the message back to what it was in Avicore

Chat Messages

Honestly this isn't a huge issue but the brackets around our names look, well, unprofessional, it kind of implies that the server doesn't really care about communication and makes it look cheap. Of course this is incorrect but I think it'd be nice to change it so the Chat Messages doesn't make it look like a uncoordinated survival PVP server is running Avicus.

Solution
Make it look like this:
<RANK> | <username>: Look's much cleaner and less unprofessional

Badge Colours

These cosmetic things used to look good but with only the colour grey... It really doesn't give the impression that the user has saved up a lot and actually played Avicus for a long period of time. Also the colour grey just doesn't give a positive look to Avicus... So I think we should be able to change badge colours.

Solution

Allow players to change their badge colour or at least no have any boring grey-scale colours.


To Conclude

The atlas update is great, although with some bugs definitely seems like a step in the right direction. These minor design suggestions I'm pretty sure will help the server look more professional and  organised.

- Tiger
Please leave your feedback below and state your ways to fix these 'problems'
